Evidence Description: S3 Block Public Access configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify public access prevention

Evidence Description: S3 bucket policy
Verification Purpose: Verify unauthorized principals are restricted

Evidence Description: S3 encryption configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify encryption at rest

Evidence Description: Unauthorized access test results
Verification Purpose: Verify public requests are denied

Evidence Description: CloudTrail configuration and event records
Verification Purpose: Verify relevant changes are logged

Evidence Description: AWS backup plan and backup frequency configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify that backups are configured according to business requirements

Evidence Description: Backup retention and protection configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify backup retention and protection against deletion

Evidence Description: Database restoration test results
Verification Purpose: Verify that the customer database can be restored successfully

Evidence Description: Disaster recovery procedure
Verification Purpose: Verify documented recovery responsibilities and procedures

Evidence Description: Approved RTO and RPO requirements
Expected Source: Business impact analysis and management approval
Verification Purpose: Verify acceptable downtime and data loss requirements

Evidence Description: Initial vulnerability scan identifying outdated software and critical findings
Verification Purpose: Confirm affected asset, vulnerability severity, and discovery date

Evidence Description: Documented patch management policy with remediation deadlines for critical vulnerabilities
Verification Purpose: Verify that critical vulnerabilities have defined remediation deadlines

Evidence Description: Patch installation records and approved change tickets
Expected Source: Patch Management System / Change Management System
Verification Purpose: Verify that security patches were actually installed and approved

Evidence Description: Follow-up vulnerability scan after patch installation
Verification Purpose: Verify that the critical vulnerability has been successfully remediated

Evidence Description: Approved vulnerability remediation exceptions and documented compensating controls
Verification Purpose: Verify that delayed remediation is formally reviewed and approved

Evidence Description: IAM user and role MFA configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify MFA is enabled for privileged identities and required users.

Evidence Description: IAM policies and role permission assignments
Expected Source: AWS IAM policies and role configuration
Verification Purpose: Identify excessive permissions and verify least-privilege access.

Evidence Description: IAM credential inventory and last-used information
Verification Purpose: Identify unused credentials and verify credential cleanup.

Evidence Description: CloudTrail trail configuration and event coverage
Verification Purpose: Verify required account activity is being recorded across relevant regions.

Evidence Description: CloudTrail log integrity validation and storage protections
Expected Source: CloudTrail settings and S3 log bucket configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify log-file validation and protections against unauthorized log modification or deletion.

Evidence Description: Security monitoring alerts and notification test results
Expected Source: Amazon CloudWatch alarms and notification configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify suspicious activity alerts are configured and notifications work.

Evidence Description: Customer data encryption-at-rest configuration
Expected Source: Amazon S3 and AWS KMS configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify customer data is encrypted at rest using approved encryption settings.

Evidence Description: Application and service TLS configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify data in transit is protected using approved TLS settings.

Evidence Description: KMS key policies and rotation configuration
Verification Purpose: Verify key access is restricted and key rotation requirements are addressed.

Evidence Description: Periodic user and role access review records
Verification Purpose: Verify access reviews occur and unnecessary permissions are identified.

Evidence Description: Employee termination and access-removal records
Expected Source: HR termination records and IAM audit logs
Verification Purpose: Verify access is removed promptly when employment or authorization ends.

Evidence Description: Access approval and exception records
Expected Source: Access request tickets and approval records
Verification Purpose: Verify access is authorized and exceptions are documented.

Evidence Description: Production security group inbound rule configuration
Verification Purpose: Identify unrestricted or overly permissive inbound network access.

Evidence Description: Approved administrative source IPs and network change records
Expected Source: Network access approvals and change tickets
Verification Purpose: Verify remote administrative access is limited to approved sources.

Evidence Description: Cloud network configuration monitoring and alert configuration
Expected Source: AWS Config rules, CloudTrail events, and CloudWatch alarms
Verification Purpose: Verify that security group and network configuration changes are monitored, alerts are generated for unauthorized or overly permissive changes, and remediation is tracked.
